description: Record of clean-room build verifications against published release assets. The compliance runner cites this record but does not treat it as a pass: verifying a published artefact needs network access and a chosen tag, so `release-reproducibility` stays MANUAL_REVIEW and must be re-run before each release. The procedure is in docs/SECURITY-PRIVACY-CHECKS.md.

verifications.method: git worktree add <tmp> 1.1.1 && npm ci && npm run build, compared against the assets downloaded from the GitHub release

manifest.json.note: Published as a release asset but not covered by the build provenance attestation at the time of this release. `gh attestation verify manifest.json` returned HTTP 404. Fixed for future releases by adding manifest.json to the attestation subject-path in .github/workflows/release.yml.

verifications.result: All three published assets reproduced byte for byte from the tagged source with the pinned toolchain. No undeclared endpoint, secret or unaccounted-for code was found in the bundle.
verifications.caveat: Reproducibility is tied to the toolchain above. An esbuild major bump changes the bytes of main.js; that is why esbuild majors are excluded from Dependabot and are handled as a deliberate release-time decision (EXC-2026-001).
